Record Class BehaviorSettings

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.eye.behavior.BehaviorSettings
Record Components:
ambient - ambientBehaviors
minTicks - ambientMinTicks
maxTicks - ambientMaxTicks; may be below minTicks, as the server allows
pool - the ambientBehaviorPool behaviors the server recognizes
growOnHitPercent - growOnHitPercent
swirlOnHeal - swirlOnHeal
swirlHealCooldownTicks - swirlHealCooldownTicks
ongoing - the ongoing behaviors whose switches are on
public record BehaviorSettings(boolean ambient, int minTicks, int maxTicks, List<EyeBehavior> pool, int growOnHitPercent, boolean swirlOnHeal, int swirlHealCooldownTicks, Set<OngoingBehavior> ongoing) extends Record
The server's behavior settings as clients receive them, for what clients run themselves: the OngoingBehaviors on every eyed mob, and the expressions of placed mob heads and the held Googly Eye. Mob expressions stay scheduled by the server (ServerBehaviorScheduler) from ServerConfig directly.
